slides.title: One Track Under the Whole Film

units.en: A browser opens the page and moves forward one thirtieth of a second at a time.
units.zh: 浏览器打开网页，每次往前走三十分之一秒。

units.en: At every step, it takes a screenshot.
Eight browsers work side by side, | and the pictures become a video with sound.
units.zh: 八个浏览器同时工作，| 这些图片就变成了一段有声音的视频。

units.en: Finally, all the sections are joined in order.
units.zh: 最后，所有段落按顺序拼接起来。

units.en: One music track plays under the whole film, | and it softens whenever the voice speaks.
units.zh: 一条背景音乐铺满整部影片，| 每当旁白说话时，它就自动变轻。

source_text: A browser opens the page and moves forward one thirtieth of a second at a time. At every step, it takes a screenshot. Eight browsers work side by side, and the pictures become a video with sound. Finally, all the sections are joined in order. One music track plays under the whole film, and it softens whenever the voice speaks.
